authority.currentSubjectTaskRun: native existing HostGrant and ClientSession authorization

metadata.actionDigestKeys: exactly allowed_actions; no unmounted or forbidden action

lifecycle.sameActionsNewSnapshot: same binding_id; next binding_revision and new binding_digest/current mounted_snapshot_digest
lifecycle.sameExactSnapshot: same binding_id/revision/digest; Controller request still rotates native fence
lifecycle.concurrentMountValidation: short per-Session row lock; validate current snapshot before commit
lifecycle.bindingCommitValidation: same Session lock; require current mounted snapshot if present; preserve revision and narrowing guards
lifecycle.observer: no fence issued; does not implicitly release an existing lease
lifecycle.partialCommit: mount, binding and lease are separate commits; no stored bearer response or automatic credential retry
lifecycle.responseGuarantee: current observed facts, not cross-request atomic authority or immediate revocation
